issues.description: Progressive Reveal row (ii) Tool Activity mentions pressing `→` (right arrow) to expand inline, but this binding is not listed in the keybinding table (section f). The right arrow key IS bound in shell.gsx:277 as `cycleRail(1)`, so there is a potential conflict if both actions coexist. The doc should either add `→` to the keybinding table with its conflict note, or remove the `→` expand-inline action to avoid ambiguity.

The keybinding table does not mention the existing `←`/`→` (KeyLeft/KeyRight) bindings from shell.gsx:277-278 which currently map to `cycleRail(±1)`. Since the new design removes the rail concept, these bindings are effectively orphaned. The table should explicitly note that left/right arrow keys are freed by the removal of the rail, or document their new purpose (if any).
